t: This is a statue of Prince Henry the Navigator, the Portuguese prince often credited as one of the main starting forces behind the Age of Discovery. He was the third child of King John the First of Portugal, and he was a central figure in the early days of the Portuguese Empire. The statue was made by the Portuguese sculptor José Simões de Almeida. Look at the figure for a moment and think of a prince whose ambitions helped send ships out across the world.
